data.one_liner: Extracts YouTube video IDs from all kinds of valid YouTube URLs.
data.what_it_does: A minimalist Dart library that parses various forms of YouTube URLs and extracts the underlying video ID. It supports standard watch URLs, short links, embed URLs, and shorts.
use_when: You need to extract YouTube video IDs from user-provided URLs
You are building an app that embeds YouTube videos and needs to parse links
avoid_when: You need a full-featured YouTube API client for fetching playlists, comments, or uploading videos
strengths: Supports multiple YouTube URL formats including shorts and embeds
weaknesses: Performs only a single specialized parsing task
